title: Billion-scale similarity search with GPUs
authors: J. Johnson, M. Douze, H. Jégou
before: Similarity search over large vector sets ran on CPU and did not scale.
problem: Retrieval over billions of embeddings was too slow to sit inside a model's loop.
breakthrough: GPU-accelerated approximate nearest-neighbour search, released as a library.
why: The plumbing under every vector database and RAG stack. DPR and RAG both call it directly.
next: DPR and RAG used it; the commercial vector-database market grew around the same primitive.
inherits: Fast approximate vector search as an assumed capability.
